Chapter 01 · First Light第一次观测

Every observation begins
with your own eyes. 每一次观测，
都从自己的双眼开始。

You have just joined the astronomy club. Tonight, before any instrument, you learn how the eye itself sees: field of view, brightness, and the slow patience of dark adaptation.

你刚刚加入天文俱乐部。先从最熟悉的工具开始：用自己的双眼观察夜空。

Your mentor你的导师

Maya

She meets you at the observation deck on your first night. Before she lets you touch a single lens, she wants to know what you can already see.

Maya 是天文台里耐心又温柔的学姐，也是你的导师。接下来的旅程中，她会一步一步教你如何观测星空。

“Don't rush to the telescope. Tell me first — what do you see with just your eyes?” “学弟，跟我来～”
Field of View视野≈ 120° The widest view you will ever have.你的最广视野。
Limiting Magnitude极限星等~ mag 6 Fainter objects stay invisible.更暗的星星无法通过肉眼被看见。
Dark Adaptation暗适应~ 30 min Patience makes stars appear.进入黑暗后，视杆细胞逐渐恢复敏感度，让原本看不见的暗星慢慢显现。

The naked eye sees wide — but dim nebulae and small planetary disks stay out of reach. That limit is where this story begins.

在这片黑暗里，你看到的是宇宙的尺度。

A telescope is not

01 / 07

Tripod三脚架

稳定。

Two axes of motion: azimuth and altitude. It carries the tube and lets you aim.

03 / 07

Chapter 03 · Optics光学原理

Focus is not a button.调焦。

It is the meeting point of light. Watch parallel starlight enter the tube, bend through the objective, and converge on the focal plane.

光线重新汇聚的过程。看平行光进入镜筒，经过物镜弯折，最终在焦平面上会聚。

ƒFocal Length焦距 Distance from lens to focus. Longer ƒ, higher power. 目镜焦距一定时，主镜焦距越长，放大倍率越高、视野越窄。
×Magnification放大率 ƒ objective ÷ ƒ eyepiece. More is not always better. 主镜焦距 ÷ 目镜焦距，过高倍率会受到口径、视宁度和衍射极限限制，并不会无限增加细节。
°Field of View视野 Higher power, narrower view. 真实视场近似满足 目镜表观视场 ÷ 放大倍率，因此倍率越高，一次能够看到的天空范围通常越小。
ΔSharpness清晰度 Aperture, focus and air decide the detail. 实际观测还会受到大气视宁度、光学质量和对焦精度影响。

Chapter 04 · The Limit of Glass

When the limits of glass
become visible. 玻璃镜片

Push the refractor to high power and a flaw appears: glass bends each colour differently. Red and blue refuse to meet at the same focus.

放大倍率提高后，普通折射镜的色差会更加明显。玻璃对不同波长光的折射率不同，红光与蓝光无法完全汇聚在同一焦平面上。

Maya, thinking it overMaya 的思考

“The glass isn't broken. It is doing exactly what glass does — bending blue more sharply than red. So if we want the colours back together, we should stop bending light. We should bounce it.”

“玻璃把蓝光折射得比红光更厉害。或许不应该用折射，而应该用反射？”

Chapter 05 · At the Eyepiece真正的观测

Three views. One sky.三种视角，同一片夜空。

Every observation flows through three instruments. Wide to find, narrow to see. Switch between them at any moment.

天文观测通常在不同视场间切换：先用大视场完成目标搜寻，再逐步缩小视场并提高倍率，以获得更精细的结构信息。

View 1 · FOV 120° Naked Eye肉眼 The whole sky at once — but Jupiter is only a bright point. 超大视场适合建立星空方位感和粗略定位目标，但单个天体的角尺寸过小，几乎无法辨认细节。
View 2 · FOV 28° Finder Scope寻星镜 Narrower, with a crosshair. Enough to hunt the target down — still too soft to study it. 中等视场兼顾定位速度与指向精度，十字分划可用于将目标准确移入主望远镜光轴。
View 3 · FOV 6° Main Telescope主望远镜 Cloud bands, moons, nebulae, galaxies — detail at last. 窄视场配合更高放大倍率后，目标的表观角尺寸增大，行星、卫星及深空天体的局部结构开始显现。

Altitude俯仰角+38.2°

Chapter 06 · A Living Sky动态夜空

The sky never stays still.夜空从来不会静止。

The Earth turns beneath you. Stars drift out of frame, clouds pass through, and the air itself trembles. Observing means responding.

地球在你脚下转动：星体缓缓漂出视野。

Earth Rotation地球自转 At high power a target drifts out of the field in seconds. 地球自转使天球产生每秒约 15 角秒的视运动。高倍率下，目标会迅速漂出视场，因此需要持续补偿。
Clouds云层遮挡 A passing band can hide your target mid-observation. 云层会吸收和散射来自天体的光，即使薄云也会显著降低目标亮度与观测对比度。
Seeing大气视宁度 Turbulent air makes the image tremble and soften. 大气湍流不断改变光线传播路径，使星像发生抖动、膨胀和模糊，从而限制实际角分辨率。
Light Pollution光污染 City glow drowns the faintest objects. 人工照明提高天空背景亮度，降低天体与背景之间的信噪比，使暗弱目标更难被分辨。
Adapt随机应变 Lower the power, refocus, re-aim — the conditions decide. 观测条件持续变化，实际操作需要随时重新对焦、调整倍率、修正指向并等待更稳定的大气窗口。
Tracking追踪 Match the sky's motion to hold the target centered. 赤道仪或电动跟踪系统通过补偿地球自转，使目标在长时间观测中持续保持在视场中心。

From your eyes

Eight instruments. Each one earned through the story, each one changing what you can see — and how you see it.

Stage 1

Naked Eye肉眼

Refractor折射式望远镜

Chapter 08 · How They Work原理详解

Four instruments,
four ways of catching light. 四台仪器，
四种捕捉光的方式。

The refractor taught you to bend light. Everything after it bends nothing — it reflects, folds, cools, or listens. Here is exactly how.

不同类型的望远镜虽然结构各异，但分析光路时都可以归结为三个核心问题：如何收集光、在哪里形成像、光在系统中如何传播与变化。

Maya's rule of thumbMaya 的判断法则

“Ask three questions about any telescope: how does it collect light, where does the light come to a focus, and what wavelength is it built for? Answer those and you already understand the instrument.”

“面对任何一台望远镜，只要依次判断集光元件、成像位置和光路路径，基本就能读懂它的光学结构与工作原理。”

Reflector · design 01设计 01

Newtonian Reflector牛顿反射式望远镜 牛顿反射式望远镜Newtonian Reflector

Light never passes through glass. It falls the length of an open tube onto a parabolic primary mirror, which reflects it back up as a converging cone. Before that cone reaches a focus, a small flat secondary tilted at 45° folds the whole beam sideways, out through a hole in the tube wall and into the eyepiece.

Because reflection is wavelength-independent, red and blue land in exactly the same place. The colour fringing that limited your refractor is simply gone — which is why every large telescope built since 1670 uses mirrors.

光线全程不穿过玻璃。它沿着敞开的镜筒落到筒底的抛物面主镜上，被反射成一束向上收拢的光锥。在光锥尚未汇聚成焦点之前，一面倾斜 45° 的平面副镜把整束光折向侧面，从镜筒壁的开孔射出，进入目镜。

由于反射与波长无关，红光和蓝光落在完全相同的位置。困扰折射镜的色差就此彻底消失——这正是 1670 年以来所有大型望远镜都改用反射镜的原因。

The core idea: a mirror bounces every colour by the same angle, so mirrors have no chromatic aberration at all. 核心思想：镜面对所有颜色的反射角完全一致，因此反射镜根本不存在色差。
ParabolaPrimary shape — a sphere would blur the edges主镜面形——球面会产生球差
~4%Light blocked by the secondary and its vanes副镜与支架遮挡的入射光
ƒ/4 – ƒ/8Typical focal ratio常见焦比范围
Collimation准直 The routine both mirrors demand两面镜子都需要的日常校准
Mount · design 02设计 02

Dobsonian多布森望远镜 多布森望远镜Dobsonian

Optically a Dobsonian is a Newtonian. What changes is everything holding it up. John Dobson threw away the expensive equatorial mount and dropped the tube into a plywood rocker box: two large altitude bearings let it tip up and down, and the whole box turns on a ground board for azimuth. You aim by pushing it with your hand.

That simplicity is the point. Money not spent on the mount goes into glass, and a mirror gathers light in proportion to the square of its diameter — a 300 mm mirror collects nine times the light of a 100 mm one. This is the cheapest possible route to a genuinely big aperture, which is exactly what faint nebulae and galaxies require.

在光学上，多布森望远镜就是牛顿式。真正改变的是支撑它的一切。约翰·多布森抛弃了昂贵的赤道仪，把镜筒直接放进一只木质摇箱：两侧的大直径高度轴承让镜筒上下俯仰，整只摇箱则在底板上水平转动。指向目标，靠手推。

这种简朴正是它的精髓。省下的支架成本全部投入镜面，而镜面的集光能力与口径的平方成正比——300 毫米主镜的进光量是 100 毫米的九倍。这是通往真正大口径最廉价的路径，而观测暗弱的星云与星系，恰恰只认口径。

The core idea: simplify the mount to afford the aperture. Photons are what you are actually short of. 核心思想：简化支架，把预算换成口径。你真正缺的从来是光子。
D²Light gathered scales with aperture squared集光量与口径的平方成正比
200–500 mmTypical amateur aperture range常见业余口径区间
Alt–Az经纬式 Two simple axes: up-down, left-right上下与左右两个简单转轴
Hand-nudged手动轻推 No motor — you follow the drift yourself没有马达，漂移得靠你自己跟
Space · design 03设计 03

James Webb Space Telescope詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜 詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜James Webb Space Telescope

A 6.5-metre mirror cannot fit inside any rocket, so Webb's primary is built from 18 hexagonal beryllium segments plated in gold — gold because it reflects infrared far better than aluminium. The segments folded up for launch, unfolded in space, and are now held in a single continuous parabola by actuators that adjust each one to a fraction of a wavelength.

Webb observes infrared light, and infrared is heat: a warm telescope would blind itself with its own glow. That is what the five-layer, tennis-court-sized sunshield is for. Sun-facing side +85 °C, mirror side −233 °C. It works only if the Sun stays in one direction, which is why Webb orbits the L2 point 1.5 million km out, keeping Sun, Earth and Moon all behind the same shield.

The reward is what only infrared can show: light from the first galaxies, stretched by cosmic expansion out of the visible band entirely, and newborn stars still buried inside dust that visible light cannot pass.

6.5 米的镜面装不进任何一枚火箭，因此韦伯的主镜由18 块六边形铍质镜片拼成，表面镀金——因为金对红外的反射率远胜铝。这些镜片发射时折叠收拢，入轨后展开，如今由致动器逐块微调，使整体保持为一个连续的抛物面，精度达到波长的几分之一。

韦伯观测的是红外线，而红外线就是热：一台温暖的望远镜会被自身的辉光致盲。这正是那面五层、网球场大小的遮阳罩的意义所在。向阳面 +85 ℃，镜面一侧 −233 ℃。但它成立的前提是太阳始终位于同一方向——所以韦伯运行在 150 万公里外的日地 L2 点，让太阳、地球与月球始终被同一面罩子挡在身后。

回报是只有红外才能呈现的景象：最初一批星系的光，因宇宙膨胀被拉伸到完全离开可见光波段；以及仍深埋在尘埃之中、可见光无法穿透的新生恒星。

The core idea: to see heat from the early universe, the telescope must first be colder than what it is looking at. 核心思想：要看见早期宇宙的热辐射，望远镜自己必须比观测目标更冷。
6.5 mSegmented primary aperture拼接主镜口径
5 layers层 Sunshield, the size of a tennis court网球场大小的遮阳罩
−233 °CMirror-side operating temperature镜面一侧工作温度
1.5M kmDistance to the L2 halo orbit到 L2 晕轨道的距离
Radio · design 04设计 04

FAST Radio TelescopeFAST 射电望远镜 五百米口径球面射电望远镜Five-hundred-metre Aperture Spherical Telescope

Radio waves are metres long, not fractions of a micron, so a radio dish needs no polished glass — only a metal surface accurate to a few millimetres, and it needs to be enormous. FAST fills a natural karst depression in Guizhou with a 500-metre reflector made of 4,450 triangular panels hung on a steel cable net.

A sphere, though, has no single focus. So FAST cheats: 2,225 actuators beneath the net pull the cables in real time, deforming a 300-metre patch of the sphere into a true paraboloid aimed at the target. As the sky drifts, that paraboloid slides across the dish, and a feed cabin suspended on six cables 140 metres above rides along with it. Nothing here rotates; the mirror itself reshapes.

What it collects is not an image but a signal — pulsar ticks, hydrogen clouds, fast radio bursts. Radio astronomy is the point where observing stops being about looking, and becomes about listening.

射电波的波长以米计，而非微米的零点几，因此射电望远镜不需要抛光玻璃——只需要一张精度到毫米级的金属面，而且必须极其巨大。FAST 把贵州一处天然喀斯特洼地填成了一面五百米口径的反射面，由 4450 块三角形面板挂在钢索网上构成。

但球面没有单一焦点。于是 FAST 用了个巧办法：索网下方的2225 台促动器实时牵拉钢索，把球面上一块 300 米的区域主动变形成一个指向目标的真实抛物面。随着天体漂移，这块抛物面在整张大锅上平移，而悬在 140 米高空、由六根钢索牵引的馈源舱同步跟随。这里没有任何东西在转动——是镜面自己在改变形状。

它收集的不是图像，而是信号：脉冲星的滴答、氢云的谱线、快速射电暴。射电天文正是观测从“看”变成“听”的那个节点。

The core idea: too big to move, so the dish stays still and actively re-shapes itself to aim. 核心思想：大到无法转动，于是整面锅静止不动，靠主动变形来完成指向。
500 mDish diameter, set in a karst basin洼地中的反射面口径
300 mInstantaneous working paraboloid瞬时工作抛物面口径
2 225Actuators re-shaping the surface live实时改变面形的促动器
140 mFeed cabin height above the dish馈源舱悬吊高度

Why it's different差异点

Most astronomy software shows you the sky.
This one hands you the instrument. 大多数天文软件把夜空展示给你。
这一个把仪器交到你手上。

01 · The atmosphere大气

On a bad night, no aperture can buy its way past the air. 视宁度

Poor seeing imposes an absolute magnification ceiling near 55×; average seeing near 110×. A larger objective does not raise it. The source comment says why outright: without an absolute cap, a bigger lens would let a player dodge the lesson. So the answer to a turbulent night is less magnification — the single hardest habit for a beginner to accept.

大气湍流会让星像抖动、膨胀并丢失细节。视宁度为 2″ 时，即使望远镜的衍射分辨率更高，实际细节仍会被限制在约 2″；继续放大只会得到更大的模糊影像。

useful_limit_eff = min( useful_limit × seeing_eff , seeing_cap ) · observation_system.gd
02 · Assembly组装

Your build quality is your image quality.组装质量，成像质量。

Every part is scored on how cleanly you seated it, and those scores multiply straight into clarity and stability. A rushed build shows no warning dialog — it shows a blurred, shaking, dimmer target. Being out of focus costs clarity before anything else does, and the focuser is a real part: a cheap one caps how finely you can ever reach best focus.

望远镜的实际成像质量不仅取决于镜片和口径，还取决于光轴准直、焦面位置、支架稳定性与机械装配精度。轻微的倾斜或偏心就可能引入彗差、像散和失焦，使恒星从锐利的点像变成拖尾或模糊的光斑。

clarity = base_quality × assembly_score / 100 · telescope_math.gd
03 · The sky星空

The sky overhead is the actual sky.星空

43,124 catalogued stars placed by true right ascension and declination, converted the way an observatory does it — Julian date, to Greenwich sidereal time, to local sidereal time, to hour angle, to altitude and azimuth for your latitude. You travel between fourteen real observatories, from Paranal to Svalbard at 78° north.

The consequence is unusual for a game: a target genuinely below your horizon is simply not available. You wait for the season, or you travel to a site that can see it.

每颗天体的位置都由真实天球坐标计算得到。系统将赤经、赤纬结合观测地点的经纬度与时间，通过恒星时和时角转换为实时的高度角与方位角，因此同一颗星在不同地点、日期和时刻，会出现在完全不同的位置。

JD → GMST → LST → hour angle → alt / az · sky_position_service.gd
04 · Beyond visible light超越可见光

Infrared and radio are modelled, not reskinned.红外与射电

The space telescope carries the four real instruments — NIRCam, NIRSpec, MIRI, FGS/NIRISS — with filters, dither patterns and a deployment order that follows the actual sequence. The Sun must stay 85° to 135° off boresight or the thermal envelope breaks; the optics reach about 40 K, MIRI colder still. Because infrared is invisible, the image you make is a false-colour composite: you assign wavelength bands to red, green and blue yourself, and learn why every published space-telescope image is a choice someone made. The radio dish is a pointing-dynamics problem instead — momentum damped, and the whole instrument limited to 40° from zenith the way FAST genuinely is.

空间望远镜搭载四台真实仪器——NIRCam、NIRSpec、MIRI、FGS/NIRISS——配有滤光片、抖动策略与遵循真实次序的展开流程。太阳必须保持在视轴 85° 至 135° 之间，否则热控包线被破坏；光学系统降到约 40 K，MIRI 还要更冷。由于红外不可见，你产出的是伪彩色合成图你可以把不同波段分配给红、绿、蓝三个通道，由此明白：每一张公开的空间望远镜照片，都包含制作者的选择。射电观测则是一道指向动力学题：动量会衰减，整台设备被限制在天顶 40° 以内，正如真实的 FAST。

false colour: nir_short → R · nir_long → G · miri_dust → B · space_observation_model.gd
04.5 · Environmental Simulation and Optical Feedback环境模拟与光学反馈

The weather is not behind the image. It is inside the result. 观测结果的一部分。

Clouds cross the fixed eyepiece and attenuate the target in real time. Poor seeing spreads the point-spread function and limits useful magnification. City sky glow lifts the black floor, suppresses faint structure and lowers local contrast. Dark adaptation and averted vision can recover a dim nebula or galaxy, while Earth rotation carries every untracked target across the field until manual correction or an equatorial drive counters it.

云层会穿过固定的目镜视场，实时削弱目标；较差的视宁度会扩散点像，并限制真正可用的倍率；城市天光会抬高黑位、吞掉微弱结构、压低局部对比。暗适应与侧视法能重新找回昏暗的星云或星系，而地球自转会让未追踪的目标持续漂过视场，直到玩家手动修正，或让赤道仪追踪抵消它。

The optical path matters too. A refractor can leave red and blue fringes around some bright targets because its lens brings wavelengths to slightly different focus positions. A Newtonian uses mirrors for the main light path, so that lens-produced colour separation is greatly reduced. In every case the cause is communicated through the image itself, the quality score, the current objective and a specific recovery hint — not a hidden penalty.

光路本身也会改变反馈。折射镜的透镜会让不同波长落在略有差异的焦点上，因此部分高亮目标周围会留下红蓝彩边；牛顿镜以反射光路为主，显著减轻这种由大物镜产生的色差。每一种原因都会通过画面本身、质量评分、当前目标和明确的补救提示告诉玩家

environment → optical response → player action → quality result · telescope_view.gd + observation_system.gd
05 · Teaching教学

One level exists only to prove you did nothing wrong.有一关的存在，只为证明你没做错。

Level 25 is titled, in the data, The Chromatic Aberration Experiment. The instruction: repeat the Vega observation deliberately — focus, refocus, swap nothing — and confirm the coloured fringe never leaves. The description ends: this is physics, not error. Twenty-nine Concept Briefs and thirty-one skill tutorials are gated on first use, so a lesson never repeats itself into noise.

第 25 关在数据里的标题是「色差确认实验」。要求：有意重复织女星观测——调焦、再调焦、什么都不换——确认那道彩边永远不会消失。描述的最后一句是：这是物理，不是失误。29 张概念卡与 31 个技能教程都按首次使用触发，一堂课不会重复成噪音。

You are not just

Why every upgrade needs a reason为什么每次升级都要有理由

“A bigger telescope is not a reward. It is an answer to a problem you actually ran into last night — a target too faint, a colour fringe you could not remove, a wavelength your glass simply cannot pass.”
